Bare text followed by a paragraph inside a blockquote gets a blank-line separator instead of merging into one line

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<blockquote>Just text, then <p>a paragraph</p></blockquote>", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result)
```
